startup.task: Discover, compile, package and load a private QA world
startup.limits: GAME or compile alone proves startup only. Validate serialized classes and attributes in a native load.

damage.task: Batch native projectile, blast, fragment and component/crew regressions
damage.limits: Preserve authored ammunition and native contacts/callbacks; no health setters. Expected outcomes are engine regression contracts, not real-world armor claims. Repeated identical outcomes do not prove independent probabilities or a controllable RNG seed.

mobility.task: Tracked driving, reverse, slope, turning and traction comparisons
mobility.limits: Use world time, controls before physics, actual facing, RPM/gear and signed progress. Drift, setter readback and cumulative travel cannot establish powered movement. Pin terrain/contact material for traction claims.

crew-input.task: Crew, hatch, optics, entry/exit and restored controls
crew-input.limits: Scripted seat/action success is distinct from ordinary keyboard/menu behavior. Require visible delivery and a positive control before diagnosing input. Health and loaded muzzles do not prove use.

visual.task: Native clean-camera/reference, geometry/material and lighting review
visual.limits: Use visual:capture and tools/native_capture_review.py for existing adapters. Record map/world IDs, pose, camera, weather/time and actual exposure; inspect full images for stale/loading frames, clipping and occlusion. Pixel samples are not lux.

audio.task: Audition provenance, single/twin event scheduling and native sound integration
audio.limits: Keep reference-only audio separate from distributable sources. A waveform/preview is not native integration or human listening acceptance. Use one common preview gain and explicit event ledgers; do not bake twin bursts into one-shot samples.

release.task: Frozen manifest, notices/dependencies, image size and manual publisher handoff
release.limits: Prepare a reviewable manual handoff; no publish adapter or agreement acceptance. Pin all package trio bytes. Title/size validation can fail independently. STOP/cancellation precedes any next action.

convoy.task: Native supply transfer, powered following, Hold/Resume and arrival workflows
convoy.limits: Retain original driver/truck/container identities and failed attempt history. Require per-link gaps, stable world-time dwell, actual native quantity changes and fresh powered departure. A useful delivery can coexist with a strict scenario FAIL.
